# Beauty Sleep Studio PDX

> Portland lash extension, lash lift, and brow lamination studio in Nob Hill (Northwest Portland). Licensed esthetician Haley specializes in extensions, lifts, and brows — book online or call.

- Lash Tint Only: $40

## About
Haley is a licensed Oregon esthetician with 13+ years specializing in lash extensions, lash lifts, and brow lamination. Services are tailored to each client’s eye shape and style.

## Service Area
Portland metro and surrounding cities: Nob Hill, Pearl District, Northwest Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Tigard, West Linn, Hillsboro, Gresham, Oregon City, Milwaukie, Vancouver WA, and more.
